author: nickyeow

english.text: I can't find my watch.

jyutping: ngo5 zek3 biu1 m4 zi1 baai2 zo2 heoi3 bin1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It may safely be said that he will never succeed in business.

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 paak3 sam1 hau2 gong2，keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 sat6 seng4 sai3 dou1 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't let her go out after dark.

jyutping: go3 tin1 hak1 zo2 zi1 hau6 zau6 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 ceot1 gaai1 laa3。

author: nickyeow

jyutping: zi1 fo2 zin3 ji4 gaa1 jing1 goi1 ji5 ging1 dou3 zo2 jyut6 kau4 laa3。

author: nickyeow

jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 dung3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What are you learning at school?

jyutping: nei5 hai2 hok6 haau6 hok6 gan2 di1 me1 aa3？

english.text: How come you didn't say anything?

jyutping: nei5 zou6 me1 lap1 seng1 m4 ceot1 ge3？
text: 你做咩粒聲唔出嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You'd better not tell him.

jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2。
text: 你最好都係唔好同佢講。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He's a plain speaker.

jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 zik6 zip3。

english.text: I've worn holes in my socks.

jyutping: jat1 nin4 jat1 ci3 m4 hai6 hou2 mat6 ze1。

author: kaenif

english.text: I shouldn't have left you alone.

author: nickyeow

english.text: When we stepped off the bus we were immediately surrounded by a throng of children from the village.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 lok6 baa1 si2，zau6 zik1 hak1 bei2 jat1 daai6 baan1 hai2 tiu4 cyun1 dou3 lai4 ge3 sai3 lou6 baau1 wai4 zyu6。

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 jau5 nei5 bong1 sau2，ngo5 saang1 ji3 jat1 ding6 m4 wui5 gam3 sing4 gung1。

jyutping: gwong1 sin3 wui6 kap1 jan5 kwan1 cung4。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will we arrive on time?

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 m4 wui5 zeon2 si4 heoi3 dou3 gaa3？

author: kaenif

author: nickyeow

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I was the only one there who knew that Tom was unhappy.

jyutping: dak1 ngo5 sin1 zi1 aa3 tong1 m4 hoi1 sam1。

english.text: Why must people kneel down to pray? If I really wanted to pray I'll tell you what I'd do. I'd go out into a great big field all alone or into the deep, deep, woods, and I'd look up into the sky--up--up--up--into that lovely blue sky that looks as if there was no end to its blueness. And then I'd just feel a prayer.

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 jan4 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gwai6 dai1 kei4 tou2？jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 soeng2 kei4 tou2，ngo5 wui5 waa6 nei5 zi1 ngo5 wui5 dim2 zou6。ngo5 wui5 jat1 go3 jan4 ceot1 heoi3 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 tin4 je5，waak6 ze2 jap6 heoi3 sam1 sam1 ge3 sam1 lam4，jin4 hau6 ngo5 wui5 toi4 tau4 mong6 zyu6 tin1 hung1 —— hoeng3 soeng6 —— hoeng3 soeng6 —— mong6 zyu6 go2 go3 hou2 ci5 hou2 ho2 oi3 ge3 laam4 tin1, keoi5 ge3 laam4 sik1 hai6 mou5 zi2 ging2 ge3，jin4 hau6 ngo5 zi2 wui5 gam2 dou3 jat1 go3 kei4 tou2。
text: 點解人哋一定要跪低祈禱？如果我真係想祈禱，我會話你知我會點做。我會一個人出去一個好大嘅田野，或者入去深深嘅森林，然後我會抬頭望住天空 —— 向上 —— 向上 —— 望住嗰個好似好可愛嘅藍天, 佢嘅藍色係冇止境嘅，然後我只會感到一個祈禱。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Where are you from, Mark?" "I'm from the whimsical land of Glee on Wonderful Island, where fairies and elves live." "Really?" "Yes." "You sure?" "Well, when I say I'm from there, what I really mean is that a friend of a friend of a friend of a cousin of a friend of a guy I met once has sort of seen it in a book..." "Then why did you say you were from there?" "To see if you were paying attention."

text: 「你嚟自邊度，馬克？」「我嚟自奇妙島嘅奇幻之地，仙女同精靈都住喺嗰度。」「真係？」「係呀。」「你肯定？」「好啦，當我話我嚟自嗰度，我真正嘅意思係，我曾經見過嘅一個朋友嘅朋友嘅朋友嘅朋友喺書入面見過呢件事 ...... 」「噉你點解話你係嗰度嘅人？」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A grey day it is on the 4th of November of 2021. At the pizzeria, I could not sit eating my pizza at my regular table just outside the window, as a crowd of fresh brown teenagers were eating pizza there. So, I sat inside by the window. I could see the hairy arms of one brown teenager at the table outside. I went then to the cafe to have my usual iced green tea. I saw a longtime Filipino friend named Alma, who worked before at a corner convenience store, but now is in health care.

jyutping: 2021 nin4 11 jyut6 4 hou6 hai6 jat1 go3 fui1 sik1 ge3 jat6 zi2。hai2 bok6 beng2 pou2，ngo5 zo6 m4 dou2 hai2 coeng1 ngoi6 ge3 ngo5 zoeng1 pou2 tung1 toi2 dou6 sik6 gan2 ngo5 ge3 bok6 beng2，jan1 wai6 jat1 baan1 san1 sin1 ge3 fe1 sik1 cing1 siu3 nin4 hai2 dou6 sik6 gan2 bok6 beng2。so2 ji5，ngo5 zo6 hai2 jap6 min6 coeng1 bin1。ngo5 ho2 ji5 tai2 dou3 ceot1 min2 zoeng1 toi2 dou6 jau5 go3 fe1 sik1 siu3 nin4 ge3 mou4 jung4 jung4 ge3 sau2 bei3。zi1 hau6 ngo5 heoi3 zo2 gaan1 cafe jam2 ngo5 ping4 si4 jam2 ge3 bing1 luk6 caa4。ngo5 gin3 dou2 jau5 go3 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5，keoi5 giu3 Alma，keoi5 zi1 cin4 hai2 jat1 gaan1 gok3 lok6 gaan1 si6 do1 dou6 gung1 zok3，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 ji1 liu4 bou2 gin6 hong4 jip6。
text: 2021年11月4號係一個灰色嘅日子。喺薄餅舖，我坐唔到喺窗外嘅我張普通枱度食緊我嘅薄餅，因為一班新鮮嘅啡色青少年喺度食緊薄餅。所以，我坐喺入面窗邊。我可以睇到出面張枱度有個啡色少年嘅毛茸茸嘅手臂。之後我去咗間 cafe 飲我平時飲嘅冰綠茶。我見到有個好耐冇見嘅菲律賓朋友，佢叫Alma，佢之前喺一間角落間士多度工作，但係而家喺醫療保健行業。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Sometimes, we use question words like "what" in statements instead of in questions. For example, compare "What are you saying" (a question) and "I don't know what you are saying" (a statement). In Japanese, the question-marking particle か (ka), which usually marks a question, can be used in both ways. To ask "What are you saying," you may say, "何を言っているのか" (nani o itte iru no ka), using particle か (ka) to mark the question. To state "I don't know what you are saying," you may say, "何を言っているのか分かりません" (nani o itte iru no ka wakarimasen), an extension of the former. Here, か (ka) helps us in an interesting way. An English speaker, for example, may interpret this statement as, literally: "What are you saying? I don't know." It's almost as if the speaker asks themselves a rhetorical question only to respond with their own statement.

jyutping: jau5 si4，ngo5 dei6 wui5 hai2 can4 seot6 jap6 min6 jung6「me1」ni1 di1 man6 tai4 zi6 ci4，ji4 m4 hai6 hai2 man6 tai4 jap6 min6。lai6 jyu4，bei2 gaau3「nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5」（jat1 go3 man6 tai4）tung4「ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5」（jat1 go3 can4 seot6）hai2 jat6 man2 jap6 min6，tung1 soeng4 biu1 gei3 man6 tai4 ge3 man6 hou6 nap1 zi2 か（ ka ）ho2 ji5 jung6 loeng5 zung2 fong1 sik1 heoi3 man6「nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5」，nei5 ho2 nang4 wui6 waa2「なんでないだから？」（ nani o kate ）。jiu3 biu2 daat6「ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1」，nei5 ho2 ji5 gong2「なんと si1 うだった」（ nani o itte iru no ka wakarimasen ），nei1 dou6，か（ ka ）wui5 ji5 jat1 zung2 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 fong1 sik1 bong1 dou3 ngo5 dei6，lai6 jyu4，jat1 go3 gong2 jing1 man2 ge3 jan4 ho2 nang4 wui5 zoeng1 ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6 gaai2 sik1 wai6：「nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5？ngo5 m4 zi1。」caa1 m4 do1 hou2 ci5 gong2 ze2 man6 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 sau1 ci4 man6 tai4，zi2 hai6 jung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing1 ming4 heoi3 wui4 jing3。
text: 有時，我哋會喺陳述入面用「咩」呢啲問題字詞，而唔係喺問題入面。例如，比較「你講緊乜嘢」（一個問題）同「我唔知你講緊乜嘢」（一個陳述）喺日文入面，通常標記問題嘅問號粒子か（ ka ）可以用兩種方式去問「你講緊乜嘢」，你可能會話「なんでないだから？」（ nani o kate ）。要表達「我唔知你講緊乜」，你可以講「なんと思うだった」（ nani o itte iru no ka wakarimasen ），呢度，か（ ka ）會以一種有趣嘅方式幫到我哋，例如，一個講英文嘅人可能會將呢句說話解釋為：「你講緊乜嘢？我唔知。」差唔多好似講者問自己一個修辭問題，只係用自己嘅聲明去回應。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's a terrible winter-like start to summer this longest-daylight Summer Solstice Day of the 20th of June of 2025. Ugh! It was raining like cats and dogs this morning, with much cloudiness in the afternoon. I still know "reinos" in pinkish Volapük (it's raining). I had to wear my blue boots and bring my black umbrella. I've been to Tim Hortons café several times: Sausage Farmer's Wrap, Earl Grey Tea with oat milk, Lemon Poppyseed Muffin, etc. It was likely my 49th visit this year to the "Clam Temple"—the St. Albans Road's Roman Catholic church. I'm an Esperantist-Lojbanist. I'm a Syncretist, spiritually. Several people at church were wearing beige, which, I think, symbolizes Chabacano, Philippine Creole Spanish. I just enjoy sitting quietly in the nave and the adoration chapel, both mostly empty. Ah, the void... I tried to reach for a big heart-shaped leaf from the Empress Tree, "Kiri" in Japanese, but it was too high up.

jyutping: 2025 nin4 6 jyut6 20 hou6 ni1 go3 jat6 ziu3 zeoi3 coeng4 ge3 haa6 zi3 jat6，hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ci5 dung1 tin1 gam2 ge3 ho2 paa3 hoi1 ci2。gam1 ziu1 hou2 ci5 maau1 gau2 gam2 lok6 jyu5，haa6 zau3 do1 wan4。 ngo5 zung6 sik1 jung6 fan2 hung4 sik1 ge3 Volapük（lok6 gan2 jyu5）ge3「leoi4 nok6 si1」。 ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 zyu6 ngo5 deoi3 laam4 sik1 ge3 hoe1 tung4 maai4 daai3 ngo5 baa2 hak1 sik1 ge3 jyu5 ze1。 Tim Hortons café ngo5 dou1 heoi3 gwo3 gei2 ci3：hoeng1 coeng2 nung4 fu1 baau1、baak3 zoek3 caa4 pui3 maai4 jin3 mak6 naai5、ning4 mung1 aang1 suk1 zi2 sung1 beng2 dang2 dang2。gam1 nin4 hou2 ho2 nang4 hai6 ngo5 dai6 49 ci3 heoi3「gap3 lei4 miu2」 —— sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2。ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 sai3 gaai3 zyu2 ji6 ze2 - lok3 ji1 baa1 zyu2 ji6 ze2。ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 hap6 tai2 zyu2 ji6 ze2，zing1 san4 soeng6。gaau3 tong2 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 go3 jan4 zoek3 zyu6 mai5 sik1，ngo5 nam2 ni1 go3 hai6 zoeng6 zing1 zyu6 Chabacano ，fei1 leot6 ban1 hak1 lei5 ou3 ji5 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2。ngo5 zi2 hai6 zung1 ji3 zing6 zing2 dei6 zo6 hai2 zing3 tong4 tung4 sung4 baai3 gaau3 tong2，loeng5 ze2 dou1 hai6 hung1 ge3。aa3，go3 hung1 kwik1 … … ngo5 si3 gwo3 san1 sau2 heoi3 lo2 wong4 hau6 syu6 jap6 min6 jat1 pin3 sam1 jing4 ge3 daai6 jip6，jat6 man2 hai6「 Kiri 」，daan6 hai6 keoi5 taai3 gou1 dak1 zai6。
text: 2025 年 6 月 20 號呢個日照最長嘅夏至日，係一個好似冬天噉嘅可怕開始。今朝好似貓狗噉落雨，下晝多雲。 我仲識用粉紅色嘅 Volapük（落緊雨）嘅「雷諾斯」。 我要着住我對藍色嘅靴同埋帶我把黑色嘅雨遮。 Tim Hortons café 我都去過幾次：香腸農夫包、伯爵茶配埋燕麥奶、檸檬罌粟籽鬆餅等等。今年好可能係我第 49 次去「蛤蜊廟」 —— 聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂。我係一個世界主義者 - 洛伊巴主義者。我係一個合體主義者，精神上。教堂入面有幾個人着住米色，我諗呢個係象徵住 Chabacano ，菲律賓克里奧爾西班牙文。我只係鍾意靜靜哋坐喺正堂同崇拜教堂，兩者都係空嘅。啊，個空隙 … … 我試過伸手去攞皇后樹入面一片心形嘅大葉，日文係「 Kiri 」，但係佢太高得滯。
